=Classify this GitHub Issue.

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Body: {{ $json.body }}

IMPORTANT: You must output ONLY a valid JSON object matching this schema, with no markdown, no backticks, and no explanation:
{
  "type": "bug",
  "confidence": 0.95
}

Allowed values for "type":
- "bug": bug, crash, error, traceback, defect, broken functionality, unexpected behavior.
- "task": task, chore, refactoring, tests, documentation, maintenance, CI/CD, dependency upgrade.
- "feature": feature request, new functionality, new capability, enhancement proposal.
- "unknown": spam, off-topic, or completely vague/unclear (e.g. "не работает", "help", "smth broke").

Confidence guidelines:
- For clear, well-described issues with proper context: set "confidence" between 0.85 and 0.99.
- For vague, short, or ambiguous issues lacking reproduction steps or context: set "confidence" strictly BELOW 0.80 (e.g. 0.35 to 0.65).
